meta.name: fastapi-templates
meta.description: Create production-ready FastAPI projects with async patterns, dependency injection, and comprehensive error handling. Use when building new FastAPI applications or setting up backend API projects.

copy.tagline: 搭建带异步与依赖注入的生产级后端 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正准备新建一个 FastAPI 后端项目，想拥有一个良好结构的起点。
copy.tagline_en: Build production-ready FastAPI backends with async patterns and dependency injection.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to build a new FastAPI backend and want a well-structured starting point.

howto.what: 按模板搭建FastAPI项目：输出分层的目录结构（API、配置、模型、服务等），并提供依赖注入、异步处理和测试示例代码。
howto.when: 当你说要新建FastAPI应用或搭建后端API项目时触发。

say.text: 请用FastAPI模板新建一个用户管理后端项目。
say.note: 会得到分层结构的代码示例。

say.text: 帮我搭建一个带依赖注入和异步处理的FastAPI API。
say.note: Claude将按模板组织路由、服务和依赖。

say.text: 用推荐的目录结构生成FastAPI项目，并附测试用例。
say.note: 包含conftest和接口测试的写法。

howto.what_en: Guides scaffolding a FastAPI project with a layered directory structure (API, config, models, services), plus dependency injection, async patterns, and test examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to build a new FastAPI application or set up a backend API project.

say_en.text: Create a new user-management backend project using the FastAPI template.
say_en.note: You'll get a layered code example.

say_en.text: Help me build a FastAPI API with dependency injection and async patterns.
say_en.note: Organizes routes, services, and dependencies per template.

say_en.text: Generate a FastAPI project with the recommended layout and include tests.
say_en.note: Includes conftest and endpoint test examples.
